The `IllegalArgumentException` is thrown if the `returnType` parameter is not one of the types defined in `XPathConstants`. The `NullPointerException` is thrown if the `returnType` parameter is `null`.

Therefore, the `IllegalArgumentException` and `NullPointerException` are fully avoided in this context.
